name: moodle-quiz-bot
description: Manifest V3 browser extension and Tampermonkey userscript for Moodle quiz automation, Q&A harvesting, and GitHub bank syncing.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('.').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});}console.log('All JS syntax checks passed.');"
scripts.verify: npm run build:userscript && npm run check && npm test
